title: The interdisciplinary team
basis: The eleven disciplines a PACE interdisciplinary team (IDT) must include under 42 CFR 460.102(b). Titles are disciplines, not named employees.

members.title: Primary care provider
members.focus: Leads medical care, reviews changes and writes orders the rest of the team carries out.

members.title: Registered nurse
members.focus: Checks vitals and medications each visit and is first to notice a change in condition.

members.title: Social worker
members.focus: Supports wellbeing, family, caregivers and benefits; connects the plan to life at home.

members.title: Physical therapist
members.focus: Builds strength, balance and safe walking to prevent falls.

members.title: Occupational therapist
members.focus: Keeps everyday tasks possible: dressing, bathing, cooking and using devices.

members.title: Recreation therapist
members.focus: Designs activities for connection, cognition and joy; tracks engagement.

members.title: Dietitian
members.focus: Plans meals and texture for each participant's conditions and preferences.

members.title: Center manager
members.focus: Runs the day: staffing, schedule, safety and the flow of every participant through the center.

members.title: Home care coordinator
members.focus: Arranges support at home so care continues after the van drops off.

members.title: Personal care attendant
members.focus: Helps with walking, meals, toileting and personal care throughout the day.

members.title: Driver
members.focus: Brings participants safely to and from the center; often the first to see how the morning is going.

palette.note: Shared by character wardrobe accents and the story overlay. Participants wear warm neutrals.
